name: 公開記事の操作バー
prompt: Create one 1125x150 published-article action bar. Use the Guardian source crop for the four-control order and spacing; use the localized native preview for the Japanese text and Lighthouse icon treatment. Set a plain white background. From left to right, draw: a green outlined circle with a gray left-facing back arrow; a green outlined circle containing a gray bookmark outline; a green outlined circle containing a gray share-up-from-tray icon; and a green outlined circle containing the exact green label 「文字」 for text sizing. Use thin, consistent strokes, generous space between controls, and no fills in the circles. Keep all four controls vertically centered on one row. No English text, gradients, shadows, or extra decoration. Produce one flat component image.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
